purpose: Explain when and where the selected vehicle charges through returned-session summaries, weekly density, insights and location/weekday breakdowns.
primaryGoal: Understand charging habits in the shared workspace vehicle/date scope without mistaking missing measurements or a bounded response for complete history.

findings.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-045 / unknown is not zero
findings.detail: Missing energy is added as zero without an observation count; HeatmapGrid.tsx:68 formats every populated bucket's total as a measurement. All-missing energy therefore looks like measured zero, and mixed buckets lack the summary's partial-value qualification. Summary correctly distinguishes these cases at ChargingHeatmapSummary.tsx:48-50.
findings.fix: Keep recorded Wh totals and session counts, carry known/missing energy counts in HeatCell, and show unavailable/recorded-only qualification at the display boundary. Preserve valid measured zero and update coupled tests that currently pin missing-to-zero.

states.runtimeStatus: All states source-inspected only; authored tests not executed

visualIssues.detail: Density fills and duplicated legend stops hardcode electric cyan (0,240,255), green, amber and red RGBA across five bands. The multihue scale competes with semantic warning/error meaning and bypasses existing chart tokens/theme preferences.
visualIssues.fix: Have the existing chart-palette owner supply a restrained sequential density scale with sufficient contrast and a distinct no-session treatment. Derive swatches from the same stops, preserve existing band thresholds/count normalization and explicit user chart preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: Page forwards start/end calendar strings at line 51 although useRangeState exposes startInstant/endInstantExclusive at lines 117-124 and computes rolling instants at 656-669. Date-only labels cannot communicate exact rolling 24h or timezone-exclusive boundaries. Backend treatment is unknown, so actual returned-row error is not asserted.
architectureIssues.fix: Forward the existing instant bounds through the typed charging hook after verifying backend bound semantics; keep header ownership, URL/preset behavior, DST and independent business bucketing. Extend server filtering if necessary rather than filtering only this response.

architectureIssues.detail: Weekday/hour buckets use browser-local getDay/getHours, and no timezone context is passed. This is the current business-calendar behavior; equivalence to workspace/vehicle timezone has not been established. Tests deliberately use offsetless local timestamps rather than proving real offset/DST behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Document and verify intended business timezone before any modernization changes. Preserve current buckets until an explicit integration decision and offset/DST tests establish equivalence; do not silently switch to UTC or add a second range control.

architectureIssues.detail: Favorite/busiest weekday and chart/grid labels use the English DAYS constant (constants.ts:90); hours use a local zero-padded HH:00 helper. The fallback favorite phrase appends an English 's' to abbreviated weekdays. Counts in HeatmapGrid.tsx:56,68 also bypass the existing locale formatter.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse established locale weekday/time/number formatting while retaining Sunday-first bucket identity and hour meaning; translate complete favorite phrases instead of pluralizing raw abbreviations.

architectureIssues.detail: All four analyses derive from one limit=2000 offset=0 response. The summary explicitly disclaims complete history at ChargingHeatmapSummary.tsx:94, but heatmap, favorite/busiest insights and breakdown frames do not carry their own loaded-scope limitation. No hasMore/total/full-range source is consumed.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve the existing bounded-sample disclosure and make it visible alongside derived analyses/exports. Confirm backend capacity before proposing full-range aggregates; do not claim complete history or silently paginate during presentation-only work.

architectureIssues.detail: Cost totals sum cost_decimal without consulting per-session cost_currency (types.ts:178-179); summary supplies no source currency override at ChargingHeatmapSummary.tsx:59-62. Mixed-currency data or backend normalization is not established, so incorrect billing is a conditional risk, not a verified runtime defect.
architectureIssues.fix: Verify the source currency contract and retain currency identity. If the source can mix currencies, use explicit per-currency totals/limitations rather than inventing exchange conversion or relabeling raw amounts.

architectureIssues.detail: Feature imports StatMetric directly from stat-reference instead of the data-display category barrel; other current component imports follow category ownership.
architectureIssues.fix: Use the existing category export if available; report a missing type export to the barrel owner rather than changing shared files in the page item.
